name: Exa 3.0
summary: Give your app current web results, code references, and local business or product data through one search API. The new Lite tier costs $4 per 1,000 requests, with compact excerpts that help reduce model input costs.

name: Mercury 3
summary: Build fast chat apps and coding agents with a 1M-token context and an API compatible with OpenAI. Launch pricing is $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.35 per million output tokens, with 100 million free tokens to try.

name: FLUX 3 Max
summary: Turn a text prompt or starting image into a 5–20 second 720p video with native audio, with a 10-second clip rendering in about 12 seconds. Use it on fal for $2.55 per minute through November 7, then $10.20.

name: ChatGPT for Chrome tab control
summary: Let ChatGPT read across your open Chrome tabs or, in Work mode, take them over to fill forms, send messages, and download files. Install the extension and tag @Chrome in a ChatGPT Work or Codex chat.

name: GPT-Live prompt-to-voice
summary: Design a voice for a GPT-Live app by describing its accent, tone, and speaking style, without recording samples. Creation is free through the API or voice Playground, while generated speech uses regular GPT-Live session pricing.

name: Muse Spark Open
summary: Run an open-weight coding and agent model with a 1M-token context through OpenRouter, Groq, or Together, or download the weights from Hugging Face. Running it locally takes about 1 TB of memory, such as two M5 Ultra Mac Studios.

name: Personal apps on Google Play
summary: Describe an Android app in AI Studio and install it on your own phone through Google Play, with no developer account or $25 fee. Rolling out to US adults, with private sharing to friends coming later.

name: Drama 3
summary: Direct AI voiceovers in plain language, shifting emotion mid-sentence or within a single word across 83 languages. Use it in the web app or API at a $10 per million characters launch price through November 12, or download the open weights.
